proof_body:
by
  have key : ∀ (x : Quaternion ℝ), x * x = -1 ↔ x.re = 0 ∧ x.imI ^ 2 + x.imJ ^ 2 + x.imK ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h0 := congrArg (fun q : Quaternion ℝ => q.re) h
      have h1 := congrArg (fun q : Quaternion ℝ => q.imI) h
      have h2 := congrArg (fun q : Quaternion ℝ => q.imJ) h
      have h3 := congrArg (fun q : Quaternion ℝ => q.imK) h
      simp only [Quaternion.re_mul, Quaternion.imI_mul, Quaternion.imJ_mul, Quaternion.imK_mul, Quaternion.re_neg, Quaternion.re_one, Quaternion.imI_neg, Quaternion.imJ_neg, Quaternion.imK_neg, Quaternion.imI_one, Quaternion.imJ_one, Quaternion.imK_one] at h0 h1 h2 h3
      have hre : x.re = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hi : x.imI = 0 := by
          have : x.re * x.imI = 0 := by nlinarith
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hne
        have hj : x.imJ = 0 := by
          have : x.re * x.imJ = 0 := by nlinarith
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hne
        have hk : x.imK = 0 := by
          have : x.re * x.imK = 0 := by nlinarith
          exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hne
        rw [hi, hj, hk] at h0
        nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg x.re]
      refine ⟨hre, ?_⟩
      rw [hre] at h0
      nlinarith
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩
      apply Quaternion.ext <;> simp only [Quaternion.re_mul, Quaternion.imI_mul, Quaternion.imJ_mul, Quaternion.imK_mul, Quaternion.re_neg, Quaternion.re_one, Quaternion.imI_neg, Quaternion.imJ_neg, Quaternion.imK_neg, Quaternion.imI_one, Quaternion.imJ_one, Quaternion.imK_one, h0] <;> nlinarith
  refine ⟨key, ?_⟩
  refine Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun n : ℕ => (⟨0, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1), Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2), 0⟩ : Quaternion ℝ)) ?_ ?_
  · intro m n h
    have h1 : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := congrArg (fun q : Quaternion ℝ => q.imI) h
    have hm : ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hn : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2 : (m : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      field_simp at h1
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast add_right_cancel h2
  · intro n
    have hpos : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      linarith
    have hle : (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      have h1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
        exact hpos
      nlinarith
    refine (key _).mpr ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    show (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2)) ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]
    ring
target_source: (∀ (x : Quaternion ℝ), x * x = -1 ↔ x.re = 0 ∧ x.imI ^ 2 + x.imJ ^ 2 + x.imK ^ 2 = 1) ∧ {x : Quaternion ℝ | x * x = -1}.Infinite
